name: dsh-btw-plugin
description: btw - one-off context side questions for a DSH session: a temporary dialog that inherits the current session context; answers stay in the dialog unless the user reviews a compressed summary and sends it into the session.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/logic.js
scripts.test:direct: node test/logic.test.mjs && node test/host-smoke.test.mjs && node test/client-smoke.test.mjs
